title: Kiritani Haruka — Things May Change〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, about this email...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that. I replied the first time, so I'll also handle it this time around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're going through our emails at a pretty good pace. It's nice that them taking care of all that is giving us time to study...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we did just finish doing a shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, can I turn to the next page...?
Or would you like to take a little break instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! N-No, I'm okay...!
Please, turn to the next page!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When the Onin War broke out in 1467, the head of the shogunate at the time was Ashikaga Yoshimasa...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She still seems a little sleepy...
Oh, in that case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I have an idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An idea?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's hard to remember names and dates just from reading the textbook, so why don't we turn it into a game where we ask each other questions?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our quiz is supposed to be all fill-in-the-blank, so it should help us prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
I wanna give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, we'll cover what we'll be quizzed on. That's from the middle of the Muromachi period to the beginning of the Sengoku period.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's choose questions based on that and quiz each other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Then, Haruka, you start!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When the Onin War broke out, the shogun at the time was _____. Whose name goes in the blank?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you just read that part a second ago. Um, it was... Ashikaga Yoshi...Yoshimasa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Correct! You ask next, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In 1485, in what is known today as Kyoto, a large uprising known as the _____ occurred. What was it called?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The Yamashiro uprising.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Correct! That's amazing! You got it so fast!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we try some harder questions next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In _____, the Meio Coup occurred.
What year was that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that event sounds familiar, but I don't remember the year... Uhh... 1490!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Close! It was 1493.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Grr, darn...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
History's hard enough since we have to remember all these people with really similar names. But we have to memorize dates on top of that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mnemonics might make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, the Onin War started in 1467 because of a “vain act by man”, or “hito yo munashii” in Japanese.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I remember doing those in junior high. “The nightingale cries in Heian-kyo” was one of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, the Meio Coup took place in 1493, so... I-shi-ku-san...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, “Shizuku's a lovely person”!
“Ii Shizuku-san” in Japanese...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Did I do something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. We were just coming up with mnemonics for historical dates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, based on what you just said, you were referring to... 1...? 1...493...? So, 11493? Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's way in the future...
The answer's probably 1493, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but it doesn't really work since it doesn't tie itself to the Meio Coup.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In those situations, you just gotta memorize it however you can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree, since the ideas you come up with yourself are likely much easier to remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You think so? Then, I might just go with Shizuku being a lovely person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, since we've checked this many emails already, why don't we help Haruka and Minori study for their quiz?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good...
The Meio Coup means you're in the Muromachi period?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Our quiz is supposed to cover everything from the middle of that period up until the beginning of the Sengoku period.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that time in history's tough because of all the battles and people who were involved...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I remember having such a difficult time learning from just my textbook that I borrowed historical manga and novels from the library to try to remember everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Historical novels... Hehe. That's a good idea since you like to read so much, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Novels aren't always necessarily true to life, but they definitely made it much easier for me to imagine who these people were and what caused them to come into conflict.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, the diagrams they have in encyclopedic references are also really helpful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's always nice to see them plainly lay out how certain events led to future events while this other thing was happening over here and such.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Lugging them around wouldn't have been easy, but I wish I'd brought some along on this trip since I knew I wanted to study.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, Minori, but we'll just have to make do with my textbook for now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's sound asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She did give it everything she had today. We should let her rest.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Shizuku, Airi, Haruka... You're all so lovely...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Is she dreaming about the mnemonic she just came up with?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even in her dreams, she's doing the best she can. I think I'll try to come up with some mnemonics while she sleeps.)
